## Detailed Projects Overview

### 1. DevOps Accelerator
- **Stack**: GitHub Actions, Docker, AWS EC2, Linux, Bash
- **Description**: Automated continuous integration and deployment pipeline simulation. Builds, lints, tests, containerizes, and rolls out containerized services onto target AWS EC2 instances with zero manual intervention.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/singhrajvardhan/DevOps_Accelerator

### 2. EC2 + S3 Static Hosting
- **Stack**: AWS EC2, Amazon S3, Nginx, Let's Encrypt, CloudFront
- **Description**: High-performance static web hosting. Leverages Amazon EC2 running Nginx as an optimized reverse proxy with gzip compression, while offloading media assets to Amazon S3 buckets.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/singhrajvardhan/aws-ec2-s3-static-website

### 3. Personal Private Cloud
- **Stack**: Nextcloud, Docker Compose, PostgreSQL, Redis, Nginx
- **Description**: Hardened on-premise private cloud setup. Features end-to-end encrypted storage, automated nightly backups, and Redis transactional caching for high file synchronization throughput.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/singhrajvardhan/personal-private-CLoud

### 4. Infrastructure as Code Pipeline
- **Stack**: AWS CloudFormation, AWS VPC, IAM, Terraform, GitOps
- **Description**: Declarative infrastructure orchestration provisioning a multi-tier VPC across multiple availability zones, locked-down security groups, and automated validation via cfn-lint.
- **Repository**: https://github.com/singhrajvardhan/iVolve_CI-CD_Infrastructure

### 5. SecureExam Platform
- **Stack**: Python, FastAPI, WebSockets, OpenCV, Docker
- **Description**: Real-time academic proctoring platform. Uses computer vision for candidate gaze and face verification, WebSocket channels for live cheating alerts, and an async proctor monitoring interface.
- **Live URL**: https://examsystem.liveblog365.com/?i=1

### 6. Thikana Dhabla Ghosi
- **Stack**: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Google Maps API
- **Description**: Heritage archive portal presenting historical genealogies, photo galleries, and location-mapped monuments with sub-second page load times.
- **Live URL**: https://thikanadhabla.in/
